```yaml
name: Java Bulk CDK Base Publish

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'airbyte-cdk/bulk/core/base/**'

jobs:
  publish-base:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17

      - name: Detect changes in base
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          base: ${{ github.sha }}
          filters: |
            base:
              - 'airbyte-cdk/bulk/core/base/**'

      - name: Check base version
        if: steps.filter.outputs.base == 'true'
        uses: gradle/gradle-build-action@v3
        with:
          gradle-version: 8.6
          arguments: checkBaseVersion
        env:
          MAVEN_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_USERNAME }}
          MAVEN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Build base
        if: steps.filter.outputs.base == 'true'
        uses: gradle/gradle-build-action@v3
        with:
          gradle-version: 8.6
          arguments: assemble
        env:
          MAVEN_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_USERNAME }}
          MAVEN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Publish base
        if: steps.filter.outputs.base == 'true'
        uses: gradle/gradle-build-action@v3
        with:
          gradle-version: 8.6
          arguments: publishBasePublicationToMavenRepository
        env:
          MAVEN_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_USERNAME }}
          MAVEN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_PASSWORD }}
```
